reason: A proposta normal retornou seis elegíveis e zero cargos, enquanto o envelope R9/R10 declara sete campos e 14 cargos. O drift é confirmado e não pode ser aprovado/aplicado.

root_cause.revalidation: backend/app/tenderproof/publication.py::_revalidate (lines 203-223) only places a field in eligible when fresh_field.value equals the reviewed value and every reviewed evidence item passes _reproduced_evidence (lines 230-240).
root_cause.parser: backend/app/tenderproof/fafipa_t012_r4.py::extract_fields (lines 174-196) reproduces the same 14-value cargos list but emits one aggregate cargos evidence on page 2 with needle 'QUADRO DE VAGAS'.
root_cause.envelope_shape: reviewed-envelope-ready-r9.json carries 14 cargos evidence items (r9-cargo-01..r9-cargo-14), each with cargo-specific page/snippet (pages 2/3).
root_cause.why_zero: The cargo value is equal, but the 14 reviewed evidence snippets/pages are not equal to the fresh parser's single aggregate evidence. _reproduced_evidence therefore fails; cargos is put in blocked, not eligible. The normal proposal response consequently exposes six fields and zero proposed cargos.
root_cause.url_and_hash: This is not an artifact URL or SHA failure: the receipt records artifact SHA 26c059dc...1276f, local SHA match, and the six identity/date fields reproduced.

correction_bounded.required: Make the FAFIPA source-specific parser emit the same 14 cargo-specific Evidence records (artifact_id, document_sha256, artifact.url_final, exact page_number and exact snippet) as the accepted R9 envelope, or regenerate R9 with the parser's exact aggregate evidence only if the contract permits that evidence shape.
correction_bounded.fail_closed: Before any retry, run fresh extraction and assert cargos value equality, evidence cardinality 14, and _reproduced_evidence true for all 14 items; require eligible_fields to equal the seven expected fields.
correction_bounded.operational: Do not retry, approve, apply, or create another proposal until the bounded parser/evidence correction is tested and the existing proposal is handled by the integrator's normal proposal-state procedure. No backend edit was made in this diagnosis.
